records.name: Highwire Farms - Adrian MED
records.notes:
Highwire Farms is a lifestyle cannabis company dedicated to providing our patients with the best medicine available and developing premium products designed to deliver a life of good times, anytime, anywhere.

In 2015 two friends, Tony and Eric started a company called Urban Farms in a storage room located in Eric’s warehouse – they built racks, bought grow lights, ran water lines and purchased their first batch of seeds – without really knowing much about the business of indoor farming. But, they were eager to learn and determined to provide fresh heads of lettuce, basil, herbs and micro-greens to the Indianapolis community.

They loved the idea of local fresh produce being available all year long and hustled their fresh greens to local restaurants and nearby Farmer’s Markets.

They didn’t make a lot of money and killed many plants testing multiple cutting-edge growing techniques, but quickly learned from their mistakes and gained an appreciation for indoor cultivation and fresh farm-to-table products.

At first, growing marijuana wasn’t on the radar, but then they were introduced to the many health benefits of medical marijuana, and cultivation of cannabis seemed like a natural fit. So the boys bought an old farm in Michigan, became legal caregivers, dug a well, put air conditioning and grow lights up in the barn and started utilizing their new skills.
